title: Holding
description: DERIVED, NEVER STORED. Computed from the transaction ledger on every read. If this ever appears as a table in a migration, the architecture has been broken. Source of truth: docs/DATA_MODEL.md section 'Derived' and docs/ENGINE_SPEC.md sections 1-2.

symbol.description: Display only. May change over time; never key on it.

quantity.description: Net position. Positions at or below zero are closed and excluded from output.

avg_cost.description: invested / quantity. A sale removes cost proportionally, so selling never moves this number.

invested.description: The cost pool. BONUS, SPLIT_ADJ and DEMERGER_IN add quantity and leave this unchanged, which is what automatically corrects cost basis after a corporate action.

last_price.description: From the price pipe, not from ingestion. Absent price raises MissingPriceError; it is never defaulted to zero.

unrealised_pct.description: unrealised / invested. Null when invested is zero, which is undefined rather than infinite.

weight_pct.description: market_value / total market_value across all holdings.

cagr.description: (market_value / invested) ^ (365.25 / days) - 1, days from first_buy_date to as_of. A single-lump-sum approximation: treats the current weighted-average cost as if fully invested on the earliest acquisition date. Never computed at the portfolio level (ENGINE_SPEC section 5) -- per-holding only. Null when no as_of/first_buy_date/positive cost basis is available; never defaulted to zero.

day_change_pct.description: (last_price - previous_close) / previous_close -- the move since the previous close. A DAY's performance, distinct from `unrealised_pct`, which measures the whole holding period; the two are unrelated numbers that happen to look alike. The previous close is the last close before the one `last_price` reflects, walked back past weekends and holidays. Null when no earlier close exists to compare against, or when it is non-positive; never defaulted to zero, since zero would claim the price did not move.

fifo_cost.description: Cost of the surviving FIFO lots. Differs from `invested` only where a position has been partly sold. Brokers report this convention; `invested` is the weighted average that ENGINE_SPEC section 1 displays. Both are correct answers to different questions, and reconciliation needs this one.

fifo_avg.description: fifo_cost / quantity, to 4dp. What a broker holdings statement calls average price.

cost_estimated.description: True when any acquisition contributing to this position's cost pool carried an estimated rather than a documented cost. STICKY: once averaged, estimated rupees cannot be separated from verified ones, so one estimated acquisition marks the whole pool. Any surface showing invested or unrealised for a flagged holding must say so - 'cost estimated' rather than 'cost verified'. Presenting an estimate as a fact is the failure this field exists to prevent.
